name: Seeded Gauntlet
loop: Send a seeded gauntlet to a friend by link; both play identical masked rounds and compare per-round calibration afterwards.
hook: Easy viral challenge without accounts to browse.
risk: Link sharing and invite spam.
panel_note: Seeded calibration challenge by link; clean proper scoring
judge_why: Seeded 3-min gauntlet + friend link: same cards kill card-luck, Brier on a thumb slider, ladder gives mastery; best replay+social loop.
Seeded 3-min gauntlet shared by link: social without feeds or contact import; rate-limit invites, no global board

name: Brier Dojo
loop: Belts from white to black: each dojo level has generated paths with known odds, and you must match the true probability.
hook: Known ground truth lets players see exactly how far off they were.
risk: Synthetic odds must be labelled so players do not infer real markets.
panel_note: Match known true probability; clean proper scoring
judge_why: Known true odds score you on judgment, not outcome luck; belt ladder is a clean mastery curve. Ideal training mode.
Synthetic paths with known true odds: the only design where 'good prediction' is measurable without noise; cheap, no signal risk

name: Narrow Path Bridge
loop: A bridge narrows with each room. Drag your forecast range; width must fit the bridge to stay up, so you learn to be both calibrated and sharp.
hook: Visual metaphor for sharpness versus coverage.
risk: Synthetic data must be labelled.
panel_note: Bridge width metaphor sharpness vs coverage
judge_why: Narrowing bridge turns sharpness-vs-coverage into a readable run with escalating stakes.
Narrowing-bridge roguelike on synthetic paths: real fun, zero data licence cost, sharpness-vs-coverage made visible; no ranking needed

name: Boss Gap Night
loop: Every fifth room is a boss: an overnight gap. Set a probability for gap direction; log scoring means a confident miss deals huge damage to your health bar.
hook: Boss rooms teach tail-risk in a memorable moment.
risk: Log loss is hard to explain; needs simple health-bar framing.
panel_note: Boss gap, log health bar; clear and coherent
judge_why: Health bar makes log loss legible: confident misses hurt, boss rooms give run tension and flow peaks; the true roguelike here.
Boss gap rooms make tail risk memorable; health bar makes log loss legible; needs a calm run end, no instant retry prompt

name: Interval Archer / Archive Shelf
loop: Drag a range for where a masked asset lands in 10 days; a narrow range that holds scores big, a miss costs sharply.
hook: Tightening your aim while staying honest feels like archery. | Catch-up without guilt; finite catalog gives completion without a daily treadmill.
risk: Interval scoring is unintuitive; needs a one-line explainer. | Archive answers are known online, so scores there must be unranked.
panel_note: Interval scoring drill punishes both overconfidence and vagueness
judge_why: Interval Archer with a finite archive: catch-up without daily guilt; archive kept unranked.
Range drill with a finite archive shelf: completion without a daily treadmill, keyboard-adjustable handles, coverage scoring is honest and explainable

name: Confidence Ladder
loop: See a masked 30-day chart, set a probability that the next 5 days close higher, get Brier score and a calibration dot; ten rounds per run.
hook: Visible climb from sloppy to sharp bands unlocks harder charts.
risk: Players may read scores as trading skill; needs paper-only label.
panel_note: Probability slider, Brier and calibration dot, ten quick rounds; simple and honest
judge_why: Ten rounds, one slider, a calibration dot per call, harder charts unlock: tight 2-3 min core loop.
Ten-round masked slider with a calibration dot each round; simplest honest core; must label paper-only, not trading skill

name: Run-End Report Card
loop: A 3-minute run of 12 charts ends with a report card: calibration, overconfidence count, best bin, and one habit to practice.
hook: Satisfying summary at the end of each run.
risk: Habit hint must stay descriptive.
panel_note: Report card with descriptive habit hint; coverage scoring
judge_why: Run-end report card (calibration, overconfidence count, one habit) gives the reason to run again.
Run ends in a descriptive report card (calibration, overconfident count, one habit), weekly cadence: closure instead of 'one more run'

name: Overconfidence Boss / Anchor Bias Bath
loop: The boss mirrors your worst bias from past runs and makes you forecast its charts; beat it by hedging where you failed before.
hook: Personalised boss makes each run learn from you. | Bias-hunting meta quiz gives aha moments.
risk: Personal data used as a game element; keep local to the user. | Decoy manipulation may feel tricky; reveal the design afterwards.
panel_note: Personalised bias boss with log scoring is a strong learning loop; local-only
judge_why: Boss built from your own worst bias: adaptive difficulty that targets what you need to learn.
Boss built from your own past biases, kept on-device: personal replay variety, privacy-safe (P3), log scoring teaches humility

name: Ladder of Doubt / Prediction Pairs
loop: Each rung allows a wider probability range: begin capped at 40-60%, earn 10-90%, then extremes only by proving calibration.
hook: Earned freedom to be bold gives a natural progression. | Relative judgments are easier and more fun.
risk: Unlock gates may frustrate; show progress clearly. | Pairs might hint at relative stock picking; keep masked.
panel_note: Earned probability range; honest progression
judge_why: Earn the right to say 90%: range caps lift as you prove calibration. Best-designed mastery gate in the set.
Earned probability range (40-60% first, extremes later) is a clever honest progression; swap swipe for a slider

name: Skill Over Luck Rating / Boss Rush Daily
loop: Rating shows Brier skill with a confidence band; you only rank when the band separates from chance, per the app's lower-bound rule.
hook: Matches the app's TR-8 lower-bound ranking ethos. | Shared seed gives conversation, not compulsion.
risk: Slow to rank for new players; needs onboarding. | Share card may overclaim skill; add disclaimer.
panel_note: Confidence-band rank only when separated from chance
judge_why: Ranks only when your Brier band clears chance: skill, not a hot day, decides standing; mirrors TR-8 lower bound.

name: Cone Catcher + Anchor Bias Bath meta
loop: Drag a shaded cone around where the price will sit at the end; narrower cones score more if they contain the outcome; reveal sweeps the true path through; 12 cards. Meta from PS-062: Set a plausible range for next month's move on a masked chart, with a decoy earlier peak flagged on screen. The score reveals whether you anchored to the decoy.
hook: Tight-but-right feels like sniping; the trade-off is tactile.
risk: Range scoring is harder to explain; needs a one-line tutorial. | Decoy manipulation may feel tricky; reveal the design afterwards.
panel_note: Cone plus anchor-decoy: coherent, strong scoring
judge_why: Tight-but-right cone feels like sniping; reveal sweep is a great payoff. Needs presets for one thumb.
Cone catcher with anchor decoy revealed afterwards: tactile and teaches a bias; needs keyboard/preset handles for A1

name: Boss Rush Daily / Cone Of Silence
loop: A once-a-day seeded run of five masked boss charts; everyone gets the same seed, shares a pip grid, and tomorrow brings a new seed.
hook: Shared seed gives conversation, not compulsion. | One gesture, one idea: honest uncertainty.
risk: Share card may overclaim skill; add disclaimer. | Minimal; ensure synthetic label on every screen.
panel_note: Shared daily seed; coverage vs multi-choice input mismatch
judge_why: Daily seeded five-boss run with spoiler-free pip grid: shared ritual and conversation without a streak.

name: Week Season Descent + Seed Hunter meta
loop: Seven daily seeded runs form a week season; your rating is the median of your best five days, so one bad run is forgiven. Meta from CA-058: Share a seed number and a friend forecasts the exact same generated charts; compare calibration curves.
hook: Median scoring reduces tilt.
risk: Daily cadence can build habit pressure. | Seeds may be farmed; keep synthetic only.
panel_note: Median-of-best-five forgives bad day; daily seeded Brier; some habit pressure
judge_why: Week season = median of best five days: forgives a bad day, rewards consistent calibration, anti-tilt.

name: Blind Drift + Cross-Season Heirloom meta
loop: Generated random walks with hidden drift; guess the probability that the next 20 steps end above start; truth is revealed. Meta from LS-048: Finishing a season in a high division lets you pick one gentle rule modifier for the next, such as wider ranges or one extra skip, never extra score.
hook: Teaches that noise looks like trend.
risk: Synthetic only; could discourage engagement if too humbling. | Power creep; modifiers must be neutral or harder.
panel_note: Synthetic random walks teach noise; clean
judge_why: Synthetic hidden drift teaches noise looks like trend; ascension modifiers neutral or harder, never extra score (no power creep)

name: Twin Timeline
loop: Both players drag a range for where the price will land at the end of the same seeded path; narrower correct ranges beat wider ones.
hook: Rewards precision and humility together.
risk: Intervals may be gamed by always-wide; score width and coverage jointly.
panel_note: Twin-timeline range duel, width plus coverage; clean
judge_why: Async range duel on one seed: narrower-and-right wins; score width and coverage jointly to stop always-wide.
Seeded synthetic range duel scoring width and coverage jointly; synthetic avoids licensing and any read as a real call

name: Seasonal Mastery Trials + Head To Head Cone meta
loop: Pass weekly trials to hold a mastery level for the season: three trials on calibration, range honesty and bias; failing just means retrying next week. Meta from DP-044: Challenge a friend: both draw a cone for the same masked path; whoever has the narrower cone that still holds wins, shown after both finish.
hook: Clear pass or fail goals, no ranking.
risk: Low risk; ensure retry is unlimited but time-limited. | Cones framed as predictions on assets once unmasked; keep masked.
panel_note: Pass/fail weekly trials, retry allowed, no ranking; calm and skill-focused
judge_why: Weekly pass/fail mastery trials with retry, no ranking: progression without leaderboard anxiety or loss-chasing

name: Number Line Guess
loop: Estimate a hidden statistic of a masked path (return, max drawdown) as a 80% range; the result grid shows hit or miss per question.
hook: Calibration puzzle with a score that is easy to understand.
risk: Statistics jargon; use plain wording.
panel_note: 80% range, hit/miss grid; honest, tiny, swipe_lr input mismatched
judge_why: 75s daily 80% range puzzle, hit/miss grid: smallest session that still scores calibration honestly.

name: Echo Chamber Escape + Reason Tags meta
loop: A feed of confident opinions sways your slider; you score better by discounting them, and the reveal shows how much they moved you. Meta from CA-039: Tag each forecast with why (trend, reversal, gut, base rate); at the end see which tag produced your best calibration.
hook: Teaches independence from noise.
risk: Fictional opinions must not imitate real voices. | Tag results on small samples can mislead; show counts.
panel_note: Discounting fictional opinions trains anti-herding
judge_why: Fictional confident opinions sway your slider; scoring rewards ignoring them: an anti-signal game that trains independence

name: Echo Chamber Break / Brier Dojo
loop: The app tracks your bias toward calling up and shows a balance meter after each round; cards are drawn so ups and downs are equally likely, exposing the tilt.
hook: Learning about your own bias is quietly addictive. | Known ground truth lets players see exactly how far off they were.
risk: Bias labels shouldn't shame; use neutral wording. | Synthetic odds must be labelled so players do not infer real markets.
panel_note: Balanced synthetic draws expose up-bias; tilt meter is neat
judge_why: Balanced synthetic draws expose up-bias with a neutral tilt meter; cheap, educational, no real securities

name: Fog Of Candles
loop: A masked chart runs to a cutoff; swipe right for up, left for down over the next segment; the hidden future wipes in with a reveal animation; 15 cards per round.
hook: Fast swipes, instant reveal, and a calibration score that rewards honest confidence.
risk: Endless rapid loops can feel slot-like; needs session caps and no frequency rewards.
panel_note: Great thumb fit, but binary swipe cannot express confidence for Brier
judge_why: Native to the swipe feed: one-thumb, instant reveal, capped at three a day. Needs swipe-distance confidence.
